title: Tokimeki Mahjong Paradise: Koi no Tenpai Beat
native_title: ときめき麻雀パラダイス ～恋のてんぱいビート～
overview: Tokimeki Mahjong Paradise: Koi no Tenpai Beat is a Mahjong tile-based game with two game modes. The Date Mode has the player competing against five girls to win their hearts. Each time they lose a match, the girls strip of some of their clothing in a cutscene, but whenever the player loses, they refuse any further favors. The Free Play allows the player to practice the game without any rewards for winning or consequences for losing.
